summary: Check synchronous path existence without converting the operation into a throwing stat call.

semantics.deprecated: fs.exists is deprecated; existsSync is not

caveats: File.Exists alone returns false for directories, so it is not equivalent.
Existence checks are inherently racy; do not use this rule to justify a later operation's success.
Path-kind and symlink behavior must match Node rather than .NET convenience APIs.

tests.name: file exists
tests.expected_behavior: returns true for the created filesystem entry

tests.name: missing returns false
tests.expected_behavior: returns false rather than throwing merely because the entry is absent
